# The OC Group (OCGICT.com)

The OC Group is a real estate investment, acquisition, renovation strategy,
and consulting company based in Wichita, Kansas. Tagline: "Acquire
intelligently. Transform strategically. Build lasting value."

## What the company does
- Acquires residential properties in the Wichita, KS area, including from
  owners who want a preliminary cash offer for their property.
- Provides real estate investment consulting and renovation strategy.
- Works with investors evaluating Wichita opportunities and with a lender
  network.

## Key pages
- Home: https://www.ocgict.com/
- About: https://www.ocgict.com/about

- Sell a property / request a preliminary offer: https://www.ocgict.com/sell

- Case studies: https://www.ocgict.com/case-studies
- Contact: https://www.ocgict.com/contact

## Talking to the company
The website includes "G", an AI assistant (English and Spanish) that answers
questions about the company, explains the selling and investing process, and
collects lead information. G does not make binding offers; preliminary offers
are estimates reviewed by the team.
